material.title: Example: split a module
material.brief: Split src/lib.rs into focused modules while preserving the public API. The design notes in docs/DESIGN.md name the intended seams; keep each new module under 500 code lines and re-export the existing surface from lib.rs.

lenses.name: correctness
lenses.charter: Hunt defects in the change itself: logic errors, unhandled cases, broken invariants, concurrency hazards, silent failure paths. Assume the change is wrong and try to construct the concrete input or state that breaks it.

lenses.name: regressions
lenses.charter: Hunt collateral damage: behaviour the diff changes that the item did not ask to change. Read the surrounding code and its callers; name the existing behaviour at risk and the concrete scenario that regresses it.

lenses.name: brief_compliance
lenses.charter: Hold the diff to the item, adversarially: every stated goal either demonstrably met or a blocking finding; every scope_out boundary respected; every claimed deviation actually declared. Pass-and-still-wrong is the failure class here - do not accept a claim without evidence in the diff or gate output.
